said on Wednesday that it won a $257.3M U.S. Navy contract modification to produce and support components for the MK 48 MOD 7 Heavyweight Torpedo program.
The  deal covers production, spares, engineering support, and repairs for the U.S. Navy, the Royal Australian Navy, and the FMS program.
The work will be carried out in New York, Florida, and Massachusetts, with completion expected by September 2029.

The award includes $150.6M in U.S. Navy weapons procurement funds and $74.8M from foreign partners. Furthermore, $1.2M in fiscal 2024 Navy weapons procurement funds were also obligated and will expire at the end of the current fiscal year.
The Naval Sea Systems Command is the contracting activity.

title: Lockheed Martin lands $257M heavyweight torpedo contract modification
